scope: Public evaluation material selection; not source-registry approval or project-domain gold

pud.license: CC BY-SA 3.0; README also disclaims ownership of underlying text
pud.parallel_identity: Both fixed-release files provide parallel_id=pud/<sentence_id>; README describes 1000 corresponding professionally translated segments, except German translation provenance differs.
pud.decision: Not suitable for continuous-document alignment evaluation: README says a few randomly selected sentences per document are not necessarily adjacent. newdoc and parallel_id do not restore missing original context.

wmt19.checksum_meaning: Local content digest after complete download and successful tar decompression; no publisher checksum manifest was available in this investigation.
wmt19.licensing_basis: Official task page permits research use with WMT19 overview citation and dataset-specific citation requirements. Other uses require consulting original owners. No general production redistribution or external-model permission is asserted.
wmt19.citation: Barrault et al. (2019). Findings of the 2019 Conference on Machine Translation (WMT19), pp. 1–61. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/W19-5301
wmt19.continuity_basis: Organizer paper section 2.1 instructs all translation agencies to retain document/line boundaries and translate from scratch; table 1 identifies Chinese news documents. The task explicitly includes document-level Chinese-to-English evaluation.
wmt19.observed_identity: 163 Chinese-original documents and 2000 segments per side; exact document-ID sets and segment-ID order agree. Pairing uses docid and seg id; reference file document order is not assumed.
wmt19.experiment: Deterministically select up to 800 segments while retaining complete documents; split by document before token checks or model output. Freeze existing MiniLM revision and recipe min_score=0.55; reserve calibration without tuning. Reject entire documents containing a segment above 128 tokens, retaining their references in selected-set recall and coverage denominators.
limitations: This evaluates correspondence to public news reference segments, not independently adjudicated project-domain alignment quality.
WMT supplied translation segmentation; this does not test the project's own sentence splitter or naturally occurring split/merge relations.
No synthetic omissions or reorderings are included in this baseline.
Possible overlap with pretrained model training material has not been ruled out.
